name: records
description: first_duel_play, then ENDSEG's player records screen (mode 2) from Beginner City: register 15 of the area script set (write_mem, the one fixture: the ending sets it in play), the city menu's fourth entry (PLAYER'S DATA, with the stats hint), CIRCLE (quitToTitleOrPlayEnding(2): ENDSEG, END_runPlayerRecords), START back to SAISEG (the player data window again), TRIANGLE to the city menu. Every press waits on the state that takes it: SAISEG's SAI_AREA (waitingForCross +0x120, mode +0x10E, exitAction +0x10D, choicePhase +0x81, choiceMode +0x82, choiceCursor +0x83), SAI_PLAYER_DATA_WINDOW and SAI_STATS_HINT_WINDOW (animDone +0x41), ENDSEG's END_SECTION_OFFSETS[1] (0x5E74 once the records are counted).

steps.comment: SAI_AREA.waitingForCross: Betamon: "Don't worry, you'll get the hang of it." typed out
SAI_AREA.waitingForCross: Betamon's next message typed out
SAI_AREA.waitingForCross: the player's answer typed out
SAI_AREA.mode 2: the talk panel ("Who do you want to talk to?", SAI_tickOpponentSelectInput)

the fixture: SAI_SCRIPT[0]->regs[15] = 1 (the area script's register block is at 0x800D0E78 on both runners), the flag the ending sets in play (AREA00's script, on the first win over BlackWarGreymon, behind 300 battle wins: docs/PORT.md "What reaches ENDSEG"); with it SAI_runPlayerData opens the stats hint and takes CIRCLE
leave it: the area script opens the city menu (mode 1: SAI_tickChoiceMenu)
the city menu (choiceMode 1, four entries)
slid in: choicePhase 1 takes the pad
the fourth entry: AREA00's script opens PLAYER'S DATA (ev10.7: SAI_runPlayerData)
SAI_AREA.mode 10: the player data task runs
SAI_PLAYER_DATA_WINDOW open (animDone)
SAI_STATS_HINT_WINDOW open: register 15 is set
CIRCLE with register 15 set: SAI_AREA.exitAction 6 (AREA_EXIT_TITLE_OR_ENDING), exitArg 2
ENDSEG: quitToTitleOrPlayEnding(2), END_runPlayerRecords(parent, 2)
END_SECTION_OFFSETS[1]: the files loaded and the records counted; the window opens
START quits the records screen; SAISEG again
SAI_reopenPlayerData (resumeMode 2): the player data window again
SAI_PLAYER_DATA_WINDOW open
close it: the area script goes on to the city menu
the city menu takes the pad
